设计意图： Mutation: removed the momentum-low style gate to simplify the signal and reduce noise from binary regime switching. The core economic mechanism remains downside volatility asymmetry: stocks with higher downside volatility relative to upside volatility tend to underperform. EMA smoothing improves stability. Cross-sectional rank enhances comparability across stocks.

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. ts_ema —— 指数移动平均
    ts_ema(divide(ts_std(abs(where((subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1) < 0), subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1), 0)), 20), ts_std(where((subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1) > 0), subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1), 0), 20)), 10)
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(ts_std(abs(where((subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1) < 0), subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1), 0)), 20), ts_std(where((subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1) > 0), subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1), 0), 20))
  3. 3. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(abs(where((subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1) < 0), subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1), 0)), 20)
  4. 4. abs —— 取绝对值
    abs(where((subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1) < 0), subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1), 0))
  5. 5. where —— 条件选择/防除零保护
    where((subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1) < 0), subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1), 0)
  6. 6. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1)
  7. 7. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1))
  8. 8. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)
  9. 9. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1)

    divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1))

    ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)

  13. 13. where —— 条件选择/防除零保护
    where((subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1) > 0), subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 1), 0)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 ret：close / close.shift(1) - 1
  2. 计算 pos_ret：ret.where(ret > 0, 0)
  3. 计算 neg_ret：ret.where(ret < 0, 0).abs()
  4. 计算 pos_std：pos_ret.滚动窗口(20).std()
  5. 计算 neg_std：neg_ret.滚动窗口(20).std()
  6. 计算 ratio：neg_std / pos_std
  7. 计算 ratio_smoothed：ratio.ewm(span=10, min_periods=10, adjust=False).mean()

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_downside_volatility_asymmetry_smoothed(df): df_copy = df.copy() ret = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(1) - 1 pos_ret = ret.where(ret > 0, 0) neg_ret = ret.where(ret < 0, 0).abs() pos_std = pos_ret.rolling(20).std() neg_std = neg_ret.rolling(20).std() ratio = neg_std / pos_std.replace(0, np.nan) ratio_smoothed = ratio.ewm(span=10, min_periods=10, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() factor = ratio_smoothed factor.name = "factor_downside_volatility_asymmetry_smoothed" "kw">class="kw">return factor
